topic: Simon the ship's cat, the only cat ever awarded Britain's Dickin Medal, survived a shell but died in postwar quarantine
title: This Cat Survived A Warship Shelling. It's Not What Killed Him.
description: AI-narrated commentary on the true story of Simon, the only cat ever awarded Britain's PDSA Dickin Medal for animal bravery, wounded aboard HMS Amethyst during the 1949 Yangtze Incident.

hook_candidates.text: Britain's top medal for animal bravery has only gone to one cat, hit by a real shell that didn't kill him.
What does it actually take for a cat to earn a real military medal for bravery?
In 1949, a half-starved dockyard stray ended up trapped on a warship for ten weeks under fire.
Only one cat in history has ever won Britain's top medal for animal bravery.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who jokes their cat does nothing all day, because they want to prove one actual cat out-earned a military medal.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume this decorated war-hero cat came closest to dying when a shell hit him during battle.
closing_comment: Simon really was the only cat ever awarded Britain's Dickin Medal, and he survived a warship shelling before quarantine got him.

sources.note: Confirms Simon's Dickin Medal, his wounds during the 1949 Yangtze Incident, and his death in UK quarantine.
PDSA's own record confirming Simon is the only cat ever awarded the Dickin Medal.

beats.text: Britain's top medal for animal bravery has only gone to one cat, hit by a real **shell** that didn't kill him.

beats.text: His name was **Simon**, a stray adopted by a warship's crew.

beats.text: In **1949**, enemy shellfire hit that ship, wounding him and killing the captain.

beats.text: Rough way to start a Tuesday.

beats.text: Wounded and half-deaf, Simon still won Britain's **Dickin** Medal, the only cat ever to get one.

beats.text: Not bad for a hairball machine.

beats.text: He survived the whole siege, then died months later in a **quarantine** kennel back in Britain.

beats.text: Vets weren't fully certain the wounds caused it, but his heart never recovered.
